ops.name: HEPA element and cyclone (gas module)
ops.where: tray at the access opening, two people
ops.interval: on pressure drop across the HEPA (pain-points P11: life depends on load, not hours)

steps.step: Valve the housing off under argon; passivate by a slow air bleed with a thermocouple on the housing (P10)
Hand to the lid's right bail clip (x +60 from the housing's axis)
The inlet is on the housing's side boss, so its hose stays on: open both bail clips and lift the lid
Element out straight up: a Ø110 x 230 mm column above the can must be free
Spent element under dry sand; Class D extinguisher at hand (P34, P10)
